envelope.description: Label, gist, secret, variable, cache, ssh-key and gpg-key families

body.title: Label, gist, secret, variable, cache, ssh-key and gpg-key families
body.summary: Add gh_label, gh_gist, gh_secret, gh_variable, gh_cache, gh_ssh_key and gh_gpg_key, including stdin delivery for secret and variable values and public keys, envFile, the gist list columns, untyped key list rows, and the gist edit and rename rules; register them and carry their unit tests.
acceptanceChecks: secretValue and value reach gh on standard input and never appear in argv or error text
gist rename is destructive, gist edit offers add, remove and desc only
ssh-key and gpg-key list return rows as string arrays

tests.name: gh-family-tools.test.ts: secret and variable set deliver the value on standard input or through envFile and never in argv
gh-inputs.test.ts: gist rename's three positionals, gist edit without content or filename, exactly-one-of rules of secret, variable, cache and key adds
gh-parsers.test.ts: gist list columns and ssh-key and gpg-key rows as string arrays
